{{Quote|When the Rebel Alliance seized the port city of Salline, the Empire had to move quickly to remove the infestation.|Colonel Maximilian Veers, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="IH:ACG" />}}
The '''Pacification of Salline''' was an early engagement of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Occurring sometime in between [[2 BBY/Legends|2]]-[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Sallinedate" /> Imperial forces led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] lead an assault against Rebel insurgents at the port [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Salline/Legends|Salline]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="IH:ACG" />

==Prelude==
The Rebel Alliance had allegedly seized the city of Salline, although [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] claimed the Rebels actually had no involvement and the [[Governing council of Salline|Governing council]] of the city were simply protesting the seizure of its citizens via the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] secret police, and the reigning [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Chandrila)|Imperial Governor]] declared them traitors. Regardless, the Imperial forces led by Colonel Maximilian Veers were dispatched to maintain order.<ref name="IH:ACG" />

==Battle==
In order to avoid a repeat of the [[Debacle on Ord Torrenze]] earlier, Colonel Veers requested two [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]], [[Hammer 6]] and [[Hammer 8|8]], for providing direct fire, and four [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] for providing fire support for the AT-ATs. These were deployed via [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] sent from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Viscount (Galactic Empire)|''Viscount'']], and after getting into position advanced to Salline at 0200. The [[Government center (Salline)|government center]] on the coast was heavily fortified, but all of downtown Salline was designated a free-fire zone. Veers had Hammer 6 lead on point as well as having Hammer 8 follow at a distance of 200 meters, being placed in command of the latter. Each of the AT-ATs were flanked with two AT-STs, and they proceeded down [[Guildhead's Way/Legends|Guildhead's Way]] to the government center. 1.2 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the Imperials objective, Hammer 6 came under fire from concealed enemy [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in the upper stories of a building on the south side, although the building was smashed by Hammer 8's chin [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], with the AT-STs wiping out the troops as they fled through the ground floor, as they had learned from a similar situation from the [[Debacle on Ord Torrenze]] earlier.<ref name="IH:ACG" />

At another 400 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], the same tactic happened again, although this time the troops successfully crippled Hammer 6 by one of the [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] hitting the rear hip of the walker, which aggravated a preexisting maintenance problem. Veers then ordered for the vehicle to remain behind, acting as an elevated gun platform in order to do a 180-degree sweep of the area. Hammer 8, brought into the lead position, then blasted a hole in the security wall upon arrival, with Veers demanding for their surrender via loudspeaker. Before Hammer 8's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] contingent could rappel down to confront them, the enemy force escaped the building, with the watercraft fleeing the docks. However, they were blasted out of the water by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] dispatched at Veers' order seven kilometers south of Salline.<ref name="IH:ACG" />

==Aftermath==
Veers later wrote a report on the battle, which was later included in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' as an example of how unit support is important for armored assault.<ref name="IH:ACG" />
